steps.say: The small bin beside the class name deletes the class. It is here for a class set up by mistake or a group that has finished.
Tapping it does not delete anything on the spot. It first shows you what would go with the class, so you are deciding with the facts in front of you.
A class with real practice behind it asks you to type its name before it will go. That is the app making you say it twice on purpose.
Students keep their own accounts and everything they have learned. What goes is the class itself, its roster and its join link.
steps.terminal: That's deleting a class — shown to you first, confirmed by you, then gone. This tour changed nothing; only your own taps do.
